text:
Which statement describes a property of a magnet?
A
It attracts ferrous materials.
B
It could have only one pole (north or south).
C
It points in a random direction when suspended.
D
It repels non-ferrous materials.

options.label: B
options.text: It could have only one pole (north or south).

options.label: C
options.text: It points in a random direction when suspended.

subject: Physics
